text:
petra: quick notes from a short speculative-decode probe on ember-13b-quant. posting numbers + an eval/playbook sketch.

owen: TL;DR of the technique?

petra: run a smaller 3B-quant as a speculative decoder to produce a provisional prefix (tokens 1..T), stream those immediately, and confirm/continue with 13B quant. idea is to accept small quality loss for substantially lower first-byte latency on short responses.

lucas: how do you decide when to accept provisional tokens vs abort?

petra: perimeter checks: per-token top1_prob > 0.62 AND top1_gap > 0.24. also compute symmetric KL between small and main model logits; if sym-KL > 0.13 for any token we mark that token untrusted and re-gen from that position. cap regens to 2.

bench-bot: quick dev bench (single A100):
```
cheap (3b-4bit) p50/token ~9ms
main (13b-4bit) p50/token ~23ms
T=5 -> observed client-first-byte p50 ~57ms vs baseline ~155ms
short-prompt end2end p95 improvement ~33%
```

owen: quality numbers? auto + human?

petra: holdout 400 samples (mix QA/summarize/extract/chat): EM-like drop ~1.0% absolute, embed-cosine delta -0.011. human A/B on 60 pairs: speculative preferred 21%, baseline 63%, tie 16%. extraction & structured tasks show most regressions.

lucas: tried mitigations?

petra: two quick knobs: tighten confidence gate (0.7) — reduces regressions but halves latency win; or token-class filter (only allow whitespace/punct/function tokens) — preserves quality but almost kills speedup. also added small +0.025 length-bias merge when combining logits to reduce truncation.

owen: cost impact? running both models increases compute but may save overall tokens from main model on short sessions.

petra: short-session token usage on main model dropped ~20% so estimated per-short-session cost delta ~-10%. long sessions are neutral/worse. recommendation: route-level opt-in where median output length < 45 tokens.

lucas: what metrics/telemetry do we need for Console?

petra: prefills_attempted, prefills_streamed, prefills_confirmed, regen_count, token_symkl_p95, route_pref_success_rate, latency p50/p95. add trace spans prefill/start and prefill/confirm. also surface a token-split error counter for BPE mismatch cases.

owen: evaluation plan?

petra: proposed: 1) expanded 5k stratified holdout (QA, extract, summary, code, chat) including 1k adversarial token-split cases (names/compound/URLs). 2) run 3 configs: aggressive(T=8, conf low), balanced(T=5, conf=0.62), conservative(T=3, conf=0.76). 3) metrics: EM/ROUGE/BLEU, embed sim, regen rate, token_symKL hist, latency p50/p95, cost/session. 4) N=600 human judgments per cfg focused on extract/summarize. 5) prod canary: 1% traffic, auto rollback if regen_rate>10% or a routed-pref-drop >5% for 24h.

lucas: add adversarial taxonomies: BPE-split names, hyphenation, compound tokens, email/URL segments. surface examples in reporting.

petra: runtime notes for eng-runtime: add api flag speculative:{model, T, conf_min, symkl_thresh} and ephemeral logits store keyed by request id; stream provisional tokens with a provisional=true flag so clients can render cautiously. merge logic: when confirmed, apply token-level patching; clients should accept patch events. add prefill metrics and a lightweight fallback counter.

owen: harness command to reproduce?

petra: small harness used locally:
```
python -m evals.spec_probe --cfg configs/spec/balanced.yaml --samples 400 --out results/spec_balanced.json
```

lucas: plan SGTM. petra, please push configs + adversarial set to the spec branch and kick off the 5k runs. we'll reconvene when expanded results are in and decide rollout gating. :calendar:
